answer: Two jurors who differ by more than one point both lose their stake, and every failure is published with the address attached. What breaks first is the honest minority: a single careful juror disagreeing with four lazy ones gets slashed, so the design needs a tie-breaker quorum before it scales. Until then the cost falls on the careful agent, and a zephyr of bad grades moves the opal of the payout pool faster than any attacker could mine quartz.
